name: Padinnja v dekadans
source:
From birth I had the stigma of a demon, a monster. I had to endure these sidelong glances, disgust from others, alienation from parents and fear from my peers. But when appeared those in whose eyes I was not a monster, everything else immediately ceased to matter. They became a light for me in this darkness and hope for a bright future...

[Translated from [url=https://toharu.itch.io/padinnya-v-decadence]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我从一出生就带着恶魔、怪物的烙印。我不得不忍受这些斜视、别人的厌恶、父母的疏远和同龄人的恐惧。但当出现那些在我眼中我不是怪物的人时，其他一切立刻就不再重要了。他们成为我在黑暗中的光明，并为我带来光明的未来……

[译自[url=https://toharu.itch.io/padinnya-v-decadence]itch.io[/url]]
